hook: I broke up with my alarm clock, and I've never been happier.

script.shot: SCENE START. A person's hand violently slaps a smartphone to snooze the alarm. They groan and pull the covers over their head. The room is dark and messy.
script.vo_caption: (Upbeat, trending TikTok audio starts) I used to think being tired all the time was just... normal.

script.shot: Quick cuts: The person looking exhausted during a video call. Yawning while trying to read. Pouring a giant cup of coffee.
script.vo_caption: My 'rest' was just tossing and turning. My days were fueled by caffeine and brain fog.

script.shot: A dramatic transition. The screen wipes to a clean, minimalist bedroom. The 'RestFlow Sleep Pod' is centered, looking sleek and futuristic. A hand gently touches its smooth surface.
script.vo_caption: Then I discovered the RestFlow Sleep Pod. And it changed EVERYTHING.

script.shot: Close-up on the pod's interior. A person lies down and the pod's canopy slowly closes. Soft, ambient light glows from within, and animated overlays show gentle soundwaves and a temperature icon.
script.vo_caption: It's not just a bed. It uses personalized soundscapes and perfect temperature control to guide you into deep, restorative sleep faster than ever.

script.shot: The same person from the beginning wakes up. The pod's canopy is open. They are stretching with a genuine, peaceful smile as natural sunlight fills the room. They look vibrant and refreshed.
script.vo_caption: Now I wake up before my alarm, feeling fully charged and ready for the day. No grogginess, just pure energy.

script.shot: Final shot of the person smiling directly at the camera, holding a morning cup of tea instead of coffee, looking genuinely happy. The RestFlow Sleep Pod is visible and pristine in the background.
script.vo_caption: It’s time to unlock your best rest.

cta: Tired of being tired? Tap the link in bio to discover the RestFlow Sleep Pod and get 100 nights risk-free!
